analytical_capabilities: Perform multispectral land-cover and local-climate-zone classification from Landsat 8 raw scenes
Compare seasonal spectral patterns of built-up surfaces, vegetation, bare land, and water

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Raw quantized and calibrated digital numbers for multispectral and thermal bands; solar and view angles are supplied as angle bands.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1 only. These are Raw Tier-1 scenes, not TOA or Level-2 surface-reflectance/surface-temperature products; do not apply Level-2 SR/ST scaling factors. Landsat 8 optical bands are B2 blue, B3 green, B4 red, B5 NIR, B6 SWIR1, and B7 SWIR2; thermal bands are B10 and B11. Convert thermal digital numbers to radiance and brightness temperature using scene metadata, then apply an explicit emissivity method for LST. QA_PIXEL bit 0 is fill, bit 1 dilated cloud, bit 2 cirrus, bit 3 cloud, bit 4 cloud shadow, bit 5 snow, bit 6 clear, and bit 7 water. Use QA_RADSAT to reject saturated observations. Do not add Landsat 5, Landsat 7, Level-2, TOA, annual composites, or index-only products as required anchor data.

Level-2 surface reflectance/temperature, TOA-only collections, Landsat 8/9-only studies, precomputed composites, and workflows that omit the TM/ETM+ historical record are excluded.

directions.research_question: Assess how built-up patch structure and spatial configuration influence land surface temperature in arid urban settlements southwest of Isfahan, Iran.
directions.hypothesis_or_mechanism: Urban form metrics such as patch area, patch size, shape complexity, nearest-neighbor distance, and patch number have nonlinear and interacting effects on local land surface temperature after isolating built-up areas and removing vegetation or other confounders.
directions.variables_and_data_use: Landsat 8 and Landsat 9 Collection 2 Tier 1 Band 10 thermal DN values were converted to TOA radiance, brightness temperature, and emissivity-corrected LST; Landsat-derived NDVI supported emissivity and vegetation filtering; Sentinel-2 Level-2A 10 m bands were classified to extract built-up areas; Fragstats patch metrics served as predictors in GAMs and clustering.
directions.method_paradigm: Remote-sensing LST retrieval, supervised image classification, spatial filtering, landscape-metric computation, generalized additive modeling, and K-means clustering with residual comparison.

source_paper.title: Area-adjusted influence of built-up pattern on urban land surface temperature in an arid landscape
